scope: P1 follow-up: extended upstream semantic alignment and classification/remediation of deferred RISC-V constraints

source.result: Uncommitted changes, including preexisting ablation simplifications; historical baselines preserved.
source.hash_method: SHA256 of sorted rg --files paths (*.rs, Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, rust-toolchain.toml), each path + NUL + contents + NUL.

changes: Join array element ranges without identifying distinct singleton values (bitvec_operation).
Treat implicit numeric parameters as numeric scalars (splitreturn).
Retain constructor existential tuple evidence and parse constructor parameter patterns (ast_with_dep_tuple).
Retain literal evidence in constructor arguments; never substitute the type name int as a numeric witness (existentials2).
Propagate the surviving branch predicate after an escaping then or else branch (throw_fact).
Expand numeric and Boolean aliases in goals and assumptions, preserving complete conditional aliases.
Preserve Boolean identities, mapping equivalences, and global finite-set binders.
Project only logically implied supported assumptions for SMT entailment.
Replay confirmed overload substitutions after probe rollback; bind exact numeric inference witnesses without binding caller-owned indices.
Open each source range value for existential introduction; keep conditional existential witnesses distinct and guard their predicates.
Preserve loop endpoint, symbolic exponentiation, and existential arithmetic evidence.
Add nonnegative constraints for Nat kind parameters.
Cancel common polynomial terms, including pure conditional expressions, before enumerating residual values.
Reject incompatible call result candidates and report the full call with original parameter names.
Include active dependency diagnostics in the conformance oracle comparison.
Regenerate stale upstream oracle against the pinned current checkout.
Replace task-pool fixed-yield polling with a deadline; avoid changing process-wide panic hooks.

regressions: Non-escaping branches must not establish the condition
Conditional existential predicates must not make both branches unreachable
Nonzero-factor witness cancellation, including zero-factor rejection
